他面色苍白，咬牙站起，打量四周，发现这里是一处不大的天然洞穴，阳光顺着洞**照入，遍地都是鸟兽的尸骨。
在他身后的墙壁上，有一个拳头大小的黑洞，里面黑漆漆的看不出有多深，他略一分析，隐约得到一个答案，刚才那突然出现的吸扯力，显然就是从这小洞内传出，地面上的禽类尸骨，应该是与他一样被吸进来摔死的。
这吸力应该是不定时的出现，恰好他摔落的一刻突然涌现，这才救了他一命，王林强忍右臂疼痛，正要向洞外走去，忽然地面上的尸骨无风自动，向后涌去，王林二话不说急忙滚到一旁角落。
在这一瞬间，难以想象的庞大吸力从墙壁的小洞内出现，地面的鸟兽尸骨哗啦啦的作响，不断地被吸入小洞内，有的骨头面积较大，仿佛被生生的粘在墙壁上一样，堵住了小洞。
尽管如此，但吸力仍然剧烈，此时一只飞鸟从外面的洞**被吸入，以极快的速度啪的一声撞在墙壁上，鲜血四溅。
大约过了一个时辰，吸力消失，王林惊骇的望着地上的飞鸟尸体，没有动弹身体，而是静静的坐在原地，心里计算时间。
半个时辰后，吸力再次出现，如此循环往返数次，王林掌握了规律，这奇怪的吸力持续时间一个时辰，每次停止后过半个时辰再出现一次。
趁着一次吸力消失，王林连忙忍痛来到洞***向下一望不由苦笑，下面是一片丛林，隐约可见地面怪石峥嵘，悬崖极其陡峭，他现在手臂受伤，根本无法攀爬。距离悬崖底大约有几十丈深，若是跳下，定会摔死。
身上装有粮食的包裹，也放在了山顶并未拿下，现在食物是唯一要解决的事情，王林沉吟少许，计算着吸力降至，连忙退回洞穴贴着墙角坐下。
一天的时间飞快过去，天色渐黑，王林清晰的感觉到身体正缓缓虚弱，手臂已经彻底麻木没有知觉，思来想去，他苦笑自语道：“困在这里就是死路一条，可跳崖更是绝无活路，唉。”
他望着不远处墙角飞鸟血肉模糊的尸体，犹豫了一下，一咬牙走过去捡起，放在嘴边，一股腥臊的味道扑面而来，王林轻叹一声，二话不说放在嘴里大口的啃食生肉。
他几乎没有咀嚼直接吞下，胃部收缩翻滚涌起阵阵暖流，狼吞虎咽般很快便把飞鸟吃了一半，阵阵作呕的感觉止不住的上涌，王林连忙站起身，大口的呼吸口气，这才压了下去。
顺手把吃剩的鸟尸仍在一边，王林靠着墙壁坐下，脑子里思绪万千，一会想到父母，一会想到四叔，一会想到亲戚嘲讽的嘴脸，一会想到恒岳派黑衣中年人无情的目光。
神情恍惚间，忽然他直勾勾的盯着身旁吃了一半的鸟尸，眼都不眨一下抓过来仔细一看，只见在半截鸟尸中有一个婴儿拳头大小的红色珠子，王林把这珠子抠出，心里大感惊讶。
这飞鸟身体内怎么会有珠子？他内心砰然心动，想到在村子教书先生那里曾经看到一本叫做山海经的神话杂文，其内介绍很多动物若是活的年岁多了，身体内会形成一种叫做内丹的宝贝。
这宝贝若人吃了，可力大无穷，延年益寿，甚至连断肢都可复生。
当时他看到这描述时还颇为不信，暗自耻笑，可现在他连仙人都见到了，内心对于山海经上的一些神话传说，不由得信了几分。
王林心脏狂跳，若这珠子真是山海经上描述的内丹，那若是吃了，岂不是伤势立刻痊愈，离开这里更是轻而易举，甚至拜入仙人门派都应该问题不大，至少在毅力测试上，一定会让自己合格。

可这珠子手感硬邦邦的，不似可食之物，他眉间紧锁，用身上衣服布条把其擦拭干净，恢复了本色。
这是一个灰色的石珠，上面刻画着五朵白云，看起来颇具年代，王林大感失望，不死心的用牙咬了一下，最后摸着石珠，苦笑自语道：“铁柱，你太痴心妄想了，这世上哪有那么巧合的事情，随便摔死在面前的飞鸟就有内丹。”
叹了口气，此时外面天色已黑，带着深深的倦意，他缩在角落渐渐睡下，石珠被他随意的放在一旁的兽骨边上。
此时已是秋季，大地散热很快，尤其是山间，更是如此，丝丝凉意不断的涌入王林身体，睡梦中他紧紧抱着身子，一夜的时间很快过去。

His face turned pale, he gritted his teeth and stood up, looked around and found that this was a small natural cave. Sunlight shone through the cave and there were bones of birds and beasts everywhere.
On the wall behind him, there was a black hole the size of a fist. It was so dark that he couldn't tell how deep it was. After a brief analysis, he vaguely got an answer. The sudden suction force just now obviously came from this small hole. The bones of the birds on the ground should have been sucked in and fell to death like him.
This suction force should have appeared from time to time. It happened to appear suddenly at the moment he fell, and this saved his life. Wang Lin endured the pain in his right arm and was about to walk out of the cave. Suddenly, the bones on the ground automatically surged backwards without any wind. Wang Lin hurriedly rolled to the corner without saying a word.
At this moment, an unimaginably huge suction force appeared from the small hole in the wall. The bones of birds and beasts on the ground were being sucked into the small hole with a rattling sound. Some of the bones were larger in size, as if they were stuck to the wall, blocking the small hole.
Despite this, the suction force was still strong. At this time, a flying bird was sucked in from the hole outside and hit the wall with a bang at an extremely fast speed, with blood splattering everywhere.
After about an hour, the suction disappeared. Wang Lin looked at the dead bird corpses on the ground in horror. He did not move his body, but sat quietly, counting the time in his mind.
Half an hour later, the suction force appeared again. This cycle went back and forth several times. Wang Lin mastered the pattern. This strange suction force lasted for an hour, and appeared again half an hour after each time it stopped.
Taking advantage of the disappearance of the suction, Wang Lin hurriedly endured the pain and went to the cave. He looked down and couldn't help but smile bitterly. There was a jungle below, with jagged rocks on the ground and extremely steep cliffs. His arm was injured now and he could not climb at all. It is about dozens of feet deep from the bottom of the cliff. If you jump off, you will definitely fall to your death.
The package containing food was also placed on the top of the mountain but was not taken down. Now food was the only thing that had to be solved. Wang Lin pondered for a while, calculated that the suction power would decrease, and quickly returned to the cave and sat down against the corner.
The day passed quickly, and the sky was getting dark. Wang Lin clearly felt that his body was slowly weakening, and his arms were completely numb and had no feeling. After thinking about it, he smiled bitterly and said to himself: "Being trapped here is a dead end, but jumping off a cliff is no way to survive, alas."
He looked at the bloody corpse of Feiniao in the corner not far away, hesitated for a moment, gritted his teeth, walked over to pick it up, and put it to his mouth. A fishy smell hit his face. Wang Lin sighed softly, and without saying a word, he put it in his mouth and took a big bite of the raw meat.
He swallowed it without chewing, and his stomach contracted and rolled with waves of warmth. He quickly devoured half of the bird. The feeling of nausea was rising uncontrollably. Wang Lin quickly stood up and took a big breath before suppressing it.
Putting the leftover bird carcass aside, Wang Lin sat down against the wall with a myriad of thoughts in his mind. He thought of his parents, his fourth uncle, the mocking faces of his relatives, and the ruthless eyes of the middle-aged man in black from the Hengyue Sect.
In a daze, he suddenly stared directly at the half-eaten bird carcass beside him. Without blinking, he grabbed it and took a closer look. He saw a red bead the size of a baby's fist in the half-carcass. Wang Lin dug out the bead and was greatly surprised.
How come there are beads in this bird's body? His heart skipped a beat, remembering that he had seen a mythical essay called The Classic of Mountains and Seas from a teacher in the village, which introduced that if many animals live for a long time, a treasure called inner elixir will be formed in their bodies.
If a person eats this treasure, he will gain infinite strength, prolong his life, and even his broken limbs can be resurrected.
When he saw this descriptionHe still didn't believe it and laughed secretly, but now that he has even seen the immortals, he can't help but believe a little bit about some of the myths and legends in the Book of Mountains and Seas.
Wang Lin's heart was beating wildly. If this bead is really the inner elixir described in the Book of Mountains and Seas, then if he eats it, his injuries will be healed immediately. Leaving here will be a breeze. Even joining the Immortal Sect should not be a big problem. At least in the perseverance test, he will definitely pass the test.
But the bead felt hard to the touch and didn't look like something edible. He frowned and wiped it clean with a piece of cloth from his clothes, returning to his true colors.
It was a gray stone bead with five white clouds engraved on it. It looked quite old. Wang Lin was greatly disappointed and bit it with his teeth. Finally, he touched the stone bead and said with a wry smile: "Tie Zhu, you are too wishful thinking. There is no such coincidence in this world. Any bird that falls to death in front of you has the inner elixir."
Sighing, it was already dark outside, and with deep tiredness, he huddled in the corner and gradually fell asleep. The stone beads were casually placed beside the animal bones.
It was autumn at this time, and the earth dissipated heat very quickly, especially in the mountains. A bit of coolness continued to flow into Wang Lin's body. He hugged his body tightly in his sleep, and the night passed quickly.
